goal: Stop auto-verified seed claims in backend/services/heritage_import.py.
summary: Enforced strict epistemic integrity on claims and heritage evidence imported through backend/services/heritage_import.py. Novel imported claims are strictly prohibited from defaulting to 'verified' or 'expert_verified'. Default verification status is set to 'unreviewed' (or 'needs_source' if bibliographic citation is missing or contains placeholder/fabricated tokens). Ingestion with 'verified' or 'expert_verified' status strictly requires an explicit verified provenance record containing a valid, substantive bibliographic citation and an authenticated human expert reviewer registered in the database users table. Re-importing is fully idempotent and preserves human review decisions and reviewer notes without downgrading or overwriting existing records.
invariants_enforced: NO_AUTOVERIFIED_NOVEL_CLAIMS: Novel unverified seed claims must never default to 'verified' or 'expert_verified'.
FAIL_CLOSED_DEFAULT_STATUS: Default verification status is 'unreviewed' for claims with substantive citations, and 'needs_source' for claims with missing, blank, or placeholder citations.

AUTHENTICATED_PROVENANCE_GUARDRAIL: Claims can only enter the catalogue as 'verified' or 'expert_verified' if an explicit verified provenance record exists, backed by an authenticated human expert reviewer in the users table and valid bibliographic citations.

NEGATIVE_ABUSE_REJECTION: Fabricated, raw, or placeholder citation markers (e.g. unknown, none, n/a, tbd, placeholder, dummy, fabricated) are strictly disqualified and demoted to 'needs_source', preventing fake claims from entering as verified.

HUMAN_REVIEW_PRESERVATION: Re-importing must NEVER overwrite or downgrade human-reviewed claims; if a claim has been 'editor_reviewed', 'expert_verified', 'verified', or 'published_human_approved', its review status, reviewed_by reference, and reviewer notes (evidence_excerpt_private) are preserved intact.

changes.description: Ensured RbpcClaimEvidence defaults review_status to 'unreviewed' at database level, and added .notes property and setter mapping to evidence_excerpt_private for transparent reviewer note access.

Enhanced is_valid_bibliographic_citation to check tokenized words against disqualified markers. In import_heritage_data claim processing, prohibited novel claims from defaulting to verified/expert_verified, required authentic human reviewer and valid citation for verified status, mapped placeholder citations to needs_source, and guaranteed that re-importing preserves review status, reviewer ID, and reviewer notes on human-reviewed records.

Comprehensive test suite covering: (1) novel claims default to unreviewed/needs_source rather than verified; (2) negative abuse testing with fabricated/placeholder citations and fake reviewer IDs remaining needs_source/unreviewed; (3) idempotent re-import preserving both expert_verified and editor_reviewed statuses and reviewer notes; (4) explicit verified provenance allowing verified claim ingestion only when authenticated human reviewer and valid citation exist.

test_details.name: test_newly_imported_seed_claims_default_to_unreviewed_not_verified
test_details.assertion: Asserts newly imported seed claims default to unreviewed and are not auto-verified, even when review_status: verified is asserted in seed YAML without human reviewer.

test_details.name: test_negative_abuse_fabricated_citation_remains_needs_source_or_unreviewed
test_details.assertion: Asserts fabricated/placeholder citations and invalid reviewer UUIDs cannot elevate claims to verified; strictly defaults to needs_source/unreviewed.

test_details.name: test_reimport_preserves_human_editorial_approvals
test_details.assertion: Asserts re-importing existing items preserves expert_verified and editor_reviewed statuses and human reviewer notes, ignoring seed attempt to downgrade or overwrite.

test_details.name: test_explicit_verified_provenance_allows_verified_import
test_details.assertion: Asserts an explicit verified provenance record with a registered expert reviewer and substantive bibliographic citation is successfully ingested as expert_verified.
